searchapi.description: SearchApi MCP Server - Real-time search results as structured data from Google (web, Maps, Shopping, Flights, Hotels, News, Scholar, Images, Jobs, Trends), Bing, YouTube, Amazon and 100+ other engines, for Claude Code and other MCP clients. Remote server hosted by searchapi.io. Requires a SearchApi account (free tier available). Uses OAuth authentication; a static MCP token in the X-MCP-Token header is also supported.
